fields.notes: DALI observability is entirely protocol-level — every diagnostic surface is accessible via QUERY family + backward frame. Implementations targeting DFT-clean silicon must add scan / MBIST / ATPG at silicon level.
internal_diagnostics: QUERY LAMP FAILURE / LAMP POWER ON / LIMIT ERROR / RESET STATE / MISSING SHORT ADDRESS (0x92..0x96).
QUERY VERSION NUMBER / CONTENT DTR / DEVICE TYPE (0x97..0x99).
READ MEMORY LOCATION (0xC5) — bank 0 GTIN / firmware / hardware / IEC parts.
Failure Status flash byte (Table 2 [29]) — latched across power cycles.
RANDOMIZE / COMPARE / WITHDRAW / SEARCH / VERIFY SHORT ADDRESS — addressing-iteration observability.
exception_response_observability: No NACK — success/failure distinguished only by backward frame presence in 7..22 TE.
Latched Failure Status survives power cycle.
Memory bank 0 exposes firmware/hardware version and GTIN.
fields.scan_chain_topology: Not defined at protocol level. MSP430F2131 / G2xx2 provide JTAG / Spy-Bi-Wire debug as MCU-vendor features.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
